summary: Tenant pricing tag rename removed hourly free-buffer credits causing unexpected invoice charge
description:
Issue summary: BrightCart reports a one-off charge on their most recent invoice where an expected hourly 'free buffer' credit was not applied after a tenant policy rename. Impact: customer saw ~USD 7,400 unexpected charge for a 6-hour hybrid load window that should have been covered by their hourly buffer credits. Environment: prod (us-east-1), Dedicated tenancy (customer-dedicated-gpu-pool), billing-run (2024-11-06 02:00-08:00 UTC).

Expected behavior: Hourly free-buffer credits are applied when the tenant pricing tag is present and the hourly postbacks match buffer eligibility. Actual behavior: Buffer credits were not found in the postback attribution pipeline for the affected hours; invoicing pipeline applied standard reserved-hosted rates.

Relevant context: Customer performed an org tenant policy rename earlier that morning via the Console (renamed tenant tag from 'brightcart-main' to 'brightcart-production'). They reported the charge within 3 hours after they noticed their billing notification and requested expedited review.

Attachments: billing_line_items.csv, postback_samples_2024-11-06.json, tenant_change_audit.log
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Rename tenant tag in Console from any value to a new value that is used for pricing tagging. 2) Trigger mixed queue traffic across dedicated and hosted fallback for ~6 hours (sustained microburst pattern). 3) Observe postback ingestion and hourly aggregator. 4) Generate provisional invoice run. Expected: hourly free-buffer credits applied by the aggregator; Actual: credits absent for that tenant for the window.
logs: Postback ingestion trace IDs: pb-20241106-1a2f, pb-20241106-1a7b. Tenant service audit: tenant:update by user:carol@brightcart.com at 2024-11-06T01:02:17Z. Billing-run id: inv-run-20241106-09. Aggregator logs show 'no pricing_tag match' for tenant id brightcart-333 between 02:00-08:00 UTC. See attached postback_samples and tenant_change_audit.log for raw payloads.
investigation_notes:
Initial hypothesis: pricing-tag matching in hourly aggregator uses a cached tenant->pricing_key map that was scoped to the old tag value and invalidated incorrectly during the rename event. SRE reproduced locally by renaming a test tenant and observed a window where aggregator did not pick up new tag until cache TTL expiry.

Findings: 1) Tenant-service acknowledged the rename and emitted a tenant:update event; however the billing-service's local cache did not receive the event due to a transient NATS subscription restart at 2024-11-06T01:03:05Z. 2) Hourly aggregator reads pricing_tag from cached mapping; fallback logic only queries tenant-service on cache miss if the cache entry is explicitly null; it does not recover for mismatched tag values. 3) Several postbacks were ingested successfully, but attribution step returned 'no match' and produced a reserved-hosted rate line. 4) The customer was on a scheduled reserved capacity plan with an overlapping free-buffer entitlement defined by pricing tag which was therefore not applied.

Evidence links: dashboard: grafana.redwood.internal/d/rg8h/billing-aggregator?var=tenant=brightcart-333, log lines (billing-service): [2024-11-06T02:05:12Z] WARN pricing_matcher.go:57 "no pricing tag match for tenant brightcart-333 (cache stale)"
comments: 2024-11-07 09:12 - Maya Patel (Support): Customer submitted invoice and sample postbacks. Asked for expedited review and provisional credit if confirmed.
2024-11-07 10:03 - Liam O'Connor (Billing Eng): Acknowledged. Escalating to SRE to validate event bus deliveries and aggregator behavior.

2024-11-07 13:41 - Priya Reddy (SRE): Found NATS consumer restart around tenant update time; billing-service did not replay tenant:update. Reproduced cache-mismatch locally. Documenting mitigation steps.

resolution_notes:
Workaround applied: Billing team executed a retroactive attribution job (job id: retro-attr-20241109-02) that reprocessed postbacks for tenant brightcart-333 for window 2024-11-06 02:00-08:00 UTC using the updated pricing_tag mapping. Credits were applied and a provisional credit memo of USD 7,400 was issued against invoice INV-20241106-09.

Permanent fix: 1) Patch merged to billing-service to force explicit tenant-service lookup on tenant:update events and to treat tag mismatches as cache misses (PR: github.com/redwood/billing-service/pull/3284). 2) Added a short-lived 'replay' mechanism in the tenant event consumer to fetch missed events on restart. 3) Post-deploy runbook updated to include verify step for pricing_tag propagation after tenant rename.

Customer communication: Notified BrightCart on 2024-11-09 18:03 UTC that provisional credit applied and permanent fix scheduled for next deploy window. Customer accepted provisional credit and requested postmortem.

Follow-ups: Create INT ticket to add automated alert when pricing_tag mismatches occur in aggregator; add unit/integration tests for tag-change flows; schedule postmortem (linked: INT-33210).
final_status: Provisional credit applied; fix merged and scheduled; postmortem requested
customer_follow_up_actions: BrightCart requested a short postmortem and confirmation when change is deployed. They also asked for an exported report of the re-attribution run which Support attached to the customer email.
escalation_path: Escalated to SRE and Billing Eng; Finance involved for provisional credit approval; follow-up INT ticket created for automation.
notes_for_billing_team: Ensure retro-attr job is idempotent and records audit IDs. Retain re-attribution job logs for 90 days. Verify that credit memo INV-CM-20241109-BC maps to customer ledger brightcart-333.
